title: QPAT: A Universal Quantum Machine Learning Framework for Quantum-Assisted Training and Classical Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.33806v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning models often struggle with sharp local optima and overfitting in limited-data regimes, and exhibit limited capacity for capturing high-order, complex probability distributions. Quantum Machine Learning (QML) models, by operating in exponentially large Hilbert spaces, can efficiently represent such distributions and provide favorable inductive biases for learning, offering a promising pathway to overcome these limitations. However, their practical deployment in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era is severely hindered by gradient coupling, barren plateaus, data-loading bottlenecks, and high inference latency. To bridge classical AI and QML, we propose QPAT (QCBM-Prior-Assisted Training), a universal framework that employs a Quantum Circuit Born Machine (QCBM) as a learnable generative prior to provide a task-aligned structured inductive bias during classical model training. translated_title: QPAT：一种用于量子辅助训练与经典推理的通用量子机器学习框架
translated_abstract: 深度学习模型在有限数据情况下常常面临尖锐局部最优和过拟合的困境，并且捕获高阶复杂概率分布的能力有限。量子机器学习（QML）模型通过在指数级大的希尔伯特空间中运行，能够高效表示此类分布并为学习提供有利的归纳偏置，为克服这些局限性提供了一条有前景的途径。然而，在噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）时代，其实际部署受到梯度耦合、贫瘠高原、数据加载瓶颈和高推理延迟的严重阻碍。为了连接经典人工智能与量子机器学习，我们提出了QPAT（QCBM先验辅助训练），这是一个通用框架，它采用量子线路玻恩机（QCBM）作为可学习的生成式先验，在经典模型训练过程中提供与任务对齐的结构化归纳偏置。该框架可以无缝集成……
tldr: QPAT提出了一种通用量子机器学习框架，利用量子线路玻恩机（QCBM）作为可学习的生成式先验来辅助经典模型训练，实现“量子辅助训练+经典推理”的混合范式，既借助量子模型的归纳偏置克服深度学习在有限数据下的过拟合问题，又规避了NISQ时代量子推理延迟等部署瓶颈。
en_tdlr: QPAT is a universal quantum machine learning framework that employs a Quantum Circuit Born Machine (QCBM) as a learnable generative prior to assist classical model training, enabling quantum-assisted training with classical inference to overcome deep learning overfitting in limited-data regimes while circumventing NISQ-era quantum deployment bottlenecks.
